sources: Mortgage Eligibility Calculations (UAE Mortgage Eligibility Check: Build Logic), approved by XOTO Product — based on CBUAE Rulebook Article 3 and the CBUAE Regulations Regarding Mortgage Loans. Where the KB differed, this document is followed.
settings_note: Bank-controlled values the business can change without a code release. Central Bank values change only when the regulation does.

bank_settings.non_resident_note: The Central Bank rulebook sets no non-resident tier, so each bank decides. The standard used here is 50%; some banks offer up to 65%.

threshold_note: The regulation says 'up to AED 5 million' for UAE nationals and 'less than AED 5 million' for expats, so exactly AED 5 million gets the higher LTV for nationals and the lower LTV for expats.

ltv_table.case: UAE national, first home, value up to AED 5 million
UAE national, first home, value above AED 5 million
UAE national, second home or investment
Expat, first home, value below AED 5 million
Expat, first home, value AED 5 million or more

first_home_note: First-home terms apply when the buyer has no outstanding mortgage on another property; a fully paid-off property does not count. An investment property uses the second-home LTV. Each borrower can claim only one first home.

interest.benchmark_note: Used when the user has no rate from a bank; reviewed every 3-6 months with EIBOR (KB Art. 25-26).

upfront_costs.note: Each item is an estimate; the bank's offer and the emirate's fee schedule decide the final amounts.

disclaimers.label: estimates, not offers
disclaimers.calculator: estimate only, subject to lender approval

input_limits.note: Sanity bounds for user-provided income; values outside are treated as missing so XO asks again.
